epics.title: Core Knowledge Base (Upload, Search, Download)
epics.jtbd: When managing epidemiological materials, I want to catalog and search them by specific attributes, so that our institute's knowledge is accessible to all employees.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero hardcoded mock domain records rendered in production views
requirements: R1: The catalog search UI is patched to retrieve real domain records from the backend and handle loading/empty/error states instead of hardcoded data.

slices.title: Patch Catalog Search UI
slices.jtbd: When fixing the catalog search for this epic, I want the UI to reflect real backend data, so that false records are not displayed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the backend is stopped, When the catalog page is loaded, Then no domain records are shown and an appropriate empty/error state is displayed.
Given a search with results, When the data is fetched, Then it renders the results correctly without using hardcoded data.
Given the search UI is rendered, When accessed via keyboard, Then it is fully operable and focus is visible (WCAG AA).
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of rendered records correspond to actual backend data

epics.title: System Containerization and Launch
epics.jtbd: When operating the platform, I want a single command to start the entire system locally, so that I can verify it works end-to-end without manual configuration.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% success rate for local docker-compose launch
requirements: R1: The docker-compose override is patched to run the actual backend application and actuator, and all committed target/ artifacts are removed.

slices.title: Patch Local Backend Container Launch
slices.jtbd: When fixing the container override for this epic, I want the backend service to run the actual application, so that the local launch is functional.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a clean clone of the repository, When a developer runs docker-compose up -d, Then all services start correctly and report healthy via a real actuator health-check endpoint.
Given the codebase state, When changes are reviewed, Then no target/ build artifacts are committed.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Zero target/ artifacts committed in the repository

epics.title: Identity and Access Management
epics.jtbd: When accessing the system, I want my permissions clearly defined, so that only authorized administrators can modify the catalog while all employees can read it.
requirements: R1: The merged IAM implementation is patched so the token uses SecureRandom, the recovery link is sent outbound, and the UI correctly routes the login screen and hides role-restricted controls.
R2: The merged IAM tests are patched to verify real application paths for the upload UI and self-service recovery, rather than bypassing them.

slices.title: Patch IAM Implementation and Tests
slices.jtbd: When patching the IAM merge for this epic, I want the implementation and tests to be authentic, so that security controls are genuinely enforced.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a user requests a password reset, When the endpoint is called, Then a secure token is generated and the link is sent via an outbound channel.
Given an employee navigates to the app, When the UI loads, Then upload and delete controls are entirely hidden.
Given a locked-out user, When the test runs the self-service recovery flow, Then access is successfully restored via the actual recovery logic.
Given the login UI is displayed, When accessed via a screen reader, Then all form controls are correctly labeled and accessible (WCAG AA).
slices.tocConstraintRef: IAM test and UI implementation gaps
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% test coverage for real password recovery flow

epics.title: System Measurement (GQM)
epics.jtbd: When operating the knowledge base, I want to measure search success rates, so that I know the catalog is actually useful to the institute.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% of zero-result searches and successful downloads emit events
requirements: R1: The telemetry implementation is patched to actually trigger download success and zero-results events during real application paths.
R2: The telemetry tests are patched to set up real documents and assert against the actual emission paths, without fabricating state.

slices.title: Patch Telemetry Implementation and Tests
slices.jtbd: When fixing telemetry for this epic, I want events to fire during real operations, so that usage metrics are accurately captured and tested.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a search yields zero results, When the search concludes, Then a zero-results event is explicitly recorded by the system.
Given a test download with a properly setup document, When the action completes, Then exactly one successful download metric is recorded.

epics.title: System Backups and Resilience
epics.jtbd: When relying on the knowledge base, I want the data to be backed up regularly, so that critical epidemiological protocols are not lost in a disaster.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: 100% data integrity verified upon test restore
requirements: R1: The restore test script is patched to genuinely query the database and verify data integrity without bypassing psql.

slices.title: Patch Restore Verification Script
slices.jtbd: When fixing the restore test for this epic, I want the process to run against real database commands, so that we can trust our disaster recovery.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a recent backup archive, When a fresh environment is provisioned, Then the restore process runs successfully to completion without bypassing the database.
Given the restored environment, When data is queried, Then it genuinely matches the state at the time of the backup.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% success rate on database queries checking restored data integrity

epics.title: Launch Health Fix
epics.jtbd: When launching the platform, I want the system to start cleanly without errors, so that I can observe and verify its actual runtime behavior.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Zero connection refused errors during startup health checks
requirements: R1: The backend service launch configuration is patched to correctly start and accept connections, resolving the connection refused error on the health check.

slices.title: Patch Backend Launch Health
slices.jtbd: When fixing the launch health for this epic, I want the backend to establish connections properly, so that the local environment is usable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the local deployment configuration, When the system is launched, Then the backend service fully starts and listens on its designated ports.
Given the system is running, When the /health endpoint is polled, Then it returns a successful response without connection refused errors.
